victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: one of his colleagues in the Army
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment describes victim as a fellow Army colleague.

offence_category.quote: the shooting was a deliberate attack of murder
offence_category.reason: Court Martial found murder; offence category matches.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302; Army Act 1950 (other penalties; specific sections not stated)
statutory_provisions.quote: guilty under Section 302 of the IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Section 302 IPC and Army Act penalties are stated; no Army Act sections given.

weapon.correct_value: 7.62 mm Self Loading Rifle bearing butt number 259
weapon.quote: A 7.62 mm Self Loading Rifle bearing butt number 259
weapon.reason: Weapon and butt number match the judgment.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness (Army personnel); medical (post-mortem); recovery of cartridge cases matched to weapon; accused's remark on apprehension
evidence_type.reason: All listed evidence types appear in the judgment.

confession.correct_value: Oral remark 'MAINE JO KARNA THA KAR DIYA' made on apprehension; relied on by the Court to remove any doubt about culpability
confession.quote: it stands removed by the remark that he made when apprehended
confession.reason: Remark is an admission the Court expressly relied on.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Three shots fired at close range (8 to 10 ft) despite a warning that the person was a Quick Reaction Team member
aggravating_circumstances.quote: despite this warning the appellant fired three shots
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Close-range firing despite warning is noted in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court notes no mitigating facts; defence accident plea was not accepted.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under IPC s.302 (Court Martial); sentenced to life imprisonment plus other penalties under Army Act 1950
trial_court_outcome.quote: accordingly guilty under Section 302 of the IPC. He was accordingly sentenced to life imprisonment
trial_court_outcome.reason: Court Martial conviction and life sentence match the judgment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Writ petition under Art. 226 dismissed; Court Martial findings confirmed; recall application dismissed
high_court_outcome.quote: dismissed the writ petition and confirmed the findings of the Court Martial
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissal, confirmation and recall dismissal are all stated.

final_outcome.quote: no error can be found with the findings of fact
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, upholding conviction.

offence_finally_established.quote: guilty under Section 302 of the IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction under s.302 IPC is upheld.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment is the sentence stated.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence is not a fixed term, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but the warning came from a sentry (Naik Sajimon), not a Quick Reaction Team member.
neutral_facts.quote: followed by Naik Sajimon KT who warned him
neutral_facts.reason: Warner is described as 'another team member', but judgment identifies him as a sentry; otherwise facts are neutral and accurate.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory minimum or maximum punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: killing Naik Jityu Yadav at the spot
attempt_completion.reason: Victim was killed, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.correct_value: Death of the victim from gunshot fire (three shots fired at 8 to 10 ft)
physical_harm.quote: killing Naik Jityu Yadav at the spot
physical_harm.reason: Death by gunshot at close range is stated.

number_of_offences.quote: guilty under Section 302 of the IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Only s.302 IPC is identified as the charge and it is upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Not stated as premeditation; Court Martial found the shooting deliberate, and this finding was upheld
premeditation_planning.quote: the shooting was a deliberate attack of murder
premeditation_planning.reason: Deliberate act finding is stated; premeditation is not separately addressed.

motive.reason: No motive is accepted or alleged beyond the defence's accident plea.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Eyewitness evidence of Army personnel including PW.14's warning; post-mortem observations (PW.16) on firing distance; fired cartridge cases matching the issued weapon; accused's remark on apprehension
key_evidence_accepted.quote: borne out by the observations of Dr. S. Sharma (PW .16)
key_evidence_accepted.reason: All listed evidence is relied on by the Supreme Court.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court did not separately assess witness credibility; it accepted the Court Martial's findings of fact as free of error
witness_credibility.quote: no error can be found with the findings of fact recorded by the Court Martial
witness_credibility.reason: Court defers to factual findings without separate credibility analysis.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Quickly apprehended at the scene; made the remark 'MAINE JO KARNA THA KAR DIYA' when questioned
post_offence_conduct.quote: He was quickly apprehended by PW.14
post_offence_conduct.reason: Quick apprehension and the remark are both noted.

trial_duration.correct_value: offence: 6 January 2000; trial judgment: not given (Court Martial date not stated); High Court: 23 December 2005 (recall application dismissed 23 November 2005); Supreme Court: 19 October 2010
trial_duration.reason: Dates match the judgment, with missing Court Martial date marked not given.

legal_representation.correct_value: Accused/appellant: D.K. Thakur, D. Jha, Debasis Misra. Respondents: P.P. Tripathi, ASG, with N.S. Sweety Manchanda, Anil Katiyar, Anuj Bhandari, D.S. Mahra
legal_representation.quote: D.K. Thakur, D. Jha, Debasis Misra for the Appellant
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the appearance listing.

investigation_status.correct_value: Accused apprehended on the spot; tried by Court Martial. Police FIR and charge sheet not stated
investigation_status.quote: He was quickly apprehended by PW.14
investigation_status.reason: Apprehension and Court Martial trial are stated; FIR not mentioned.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is noted by the court.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial (Court Martial): guilty under s.302 IPC, life imprisonment. High Court: writ petition dismissed, findings confirmed, recall application dismissed. Supreme Court: appeal dismissed
appeal_history.reason: Outcome at each level matches the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Court Martial findings of fact were categoric and based on correct appreciation of evidence; interference by courts in such matters should be minimal
prosecution_argument.quote: interference by Courts in such matters was required to be minimal

defence_argument.correct_value: Killing was an accident arising from suspicion of a terrorist attack; offence under s.302 not made out
defence_argument.quote: the killing was an accident and arose from a suspicion of a terrorist attack

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Supreme Court declines to disturb concurrent findings of fact of Court Martial upheld by High Court, finding no error in them
legal_principle_applied.quote: This Court would not, in these circumstances, interfere in the assessment
legal_principle_applied.reason: Court's restraint on factual findings is accurately described.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is cited in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court does not discuss sentencing; it dismisses the appeal on facts.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court weighed these facts only on culpability, not as aggravating factors for sentence.

other_sentence_order.reason: No directions, compensation or guidelines are ordered by the Supreme Court.
